answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored in a proof-of-stake reef where each identity must bond capital against a basalt-hard collateral ledger, so mass identity creation costs scale with bonded value rather than free key generation. During a gale of forged registrations, probabilistic risk assessment flags correlated stake clustering and enforces deterministic containment by slashing. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
